description: This file defines constants, options, and interface definitions for grain components related to streaming and counters in an Orleans project. It includes interfaces for grains with counters and subscription capabilities, as well as a class for reporting options.

classes.name: StreamingConstants
classes.description: Contains constant strings used for streaming provider, namespace, and default counter grain.

classes.name: ReportingOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for reporting, including report time and duration.

methods.name: GetCounterValue
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the value of a specified counter.

methods.name: Track
methods.description: Tracks a grain with a counter-related interface.

methods.name: GetRunDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration the grain has been running.

methods.name: WaitTimeForReport
methods.description: Returns the wait time until the next report.

methods.name: GetTotalCounterValue
methods.description: Retrieves the total value for a specific counter.
